export declare const TEXT_REF_SCHEMA: SandboxSchema;

export type TextArg = {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly kind: "text";
    readonly text: string;
} | {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly kind: "number";
    readonly number: number;
    readonly style?: TextNumberStyle;
} | ({
    readonly name: string;
    readonly kind: "date";
    readonly at: string;
    readonly style: TextDateStyle;
} & TextDateOptions);

export type TextArgValue = string | number | {
    readonly kind: "number";
    readonly number: number;
    readonly style?: TextNumberStyle;
} | ({
    readonly kind: "date";
    readonly at: string;
    readonly style: TextDateStyle;
} & TextDateOptions);

export type TextArgs = Readonly<Record<string, TextArgValue>>;

export interface TextDateOptions {
    readonly time_zone?: string;
}

export type TextDateStyle = (typeof TEXT_DATE_STYLES)[number];

export type TextNumberStyle = (typeof TEXT_NUMBER_STYLES)[number];

export type TextRef = {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly args?: readonly TextArg[];
    readonly fallback?: string;
} | {
    readonly literal: string;
};

    readonly runIds: readonly string[];
    readonly sessionId?: string | null;
    readonly workspaceId?: string | null;
    readonly runSession?: string;
    readonly limit?: number;
}

export interface UiPageReviews<Element = unknown> {
    show(element: Element, query: UiPageReviewQuery, options?: {
        signal?: AbortSignal;
        onDecision?: (outcome: UiPageReviewOutcome) => void;
    }): Promise<void>;
}

export interface UiPageRouteDeclaration {
    readonly route_id: string;
    readonly path: string;
    readonly query?: readonly string[];
    readonly params?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}

export interface UiPageTaskGrants<Element = unknown> {
    place(element: Element, key: string, options?: {
        signal?: AbortSignal;
        onChange?: (state: UiTaskGrantsAreaState) => void;
    }): Promise<void>;
}

export interface UiPageTerminal<Element = unknown> {
    mount(element: Element, options: UiTerminalMountOptions): Promise<UiTerminalView>;
    send(command: UiTerminalCommand): Promise<void>;
    listen(receive: (event: UiTerminalEvent) => void): () => void;
}

export interface UiPageView<Element = unknown> {
    readDocument(query?: {
        object?: {
            id: string;
            surface: string;
        };
        input?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
        signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<string>;
    onClosing(action: {
        reference: ActionReference;
        input: unknown;
    } | null): void;
    refreshShell(): void;
    embed(element: Element, target: {
        surface: string;
        itemId: string;
        title?: string;
    }): {
        ready: Promise<void>;
        dispose(): void;
    };
}

export interface UiPageWorkspaces {
    add(path: string): Promise<{
        workspace_id: string;
    }>;
    setOutput(workspaceId: string): Promise<void>;
}

export interface UiPluginClientHost<Element = unknown, Dialog = Element, Media = Element> extends UiPageFiles<Media>, UiPageDialogs, UiPageActions {
    readonly root: Element;
    readonly scope: UiClientScope;
    readonly mount: UiClientMount | null;
    readonly search?: string;
    readonly view: UiPageView<Element>;
    openView(selection: UiViewSelection): void;
    invalidateView(): void;
    connectionSlot(request: UiConnectionSlotRequest<Element>): Promise<UiConnectionSlotChoice | null>;
    connectionNeed(place: Element, target: UiConnectionNeedTarget, options?: {
        signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<UiConnectionNeedOutcome>;
    openItem(surface: string, itemId: string, title?: string): void;
    openBeside(surface: string, itemId: string, title?: string): void;
    openPlugin(surface: string, view?: string, panel?: string): void;
    hideDirectory(): void;
    showToast(message: string, failure?: boolean): void;
    readonly pluginId: string;
    projectId(): string;
    projectTitle(): string;
    route(path: string): string;
    pluginRoute(path: string): string;
    surfaceFor(kind: string): string | null;
    readRefusal(status: number, code: unknown): string;
    confirmBox(dialog: Dialog, ok: Element, run?: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean>;
    interaction(card: Element, options: {
        onSubmit?: () => void;
    }): UiPageInteraction;
    readonly drafts: UiPageDrafts;
    readonly returns: UiPageReturns;
    readonly taskGrants: UiPageTaskGrants<Element>;
}

export interface UiRenderRequest<TModel = unknown> {
    readonly contribution_id: string;
    readonly surface: string;
    readonly model: TModel;
}

export type UiRequest = UiRequestCall & UiFailureView;

export interface UiRequestCall {
    <T = unknown>(url: string, init?: UiRequestInit): Promise<T>;
    stream<T = unknown>(url: string, init?: UiStreamRequestInit): Promise<T>;
    headers(key?: string): Record<string, string>;
    token(): string;
}

export interface UiRequestFailure extends Error {
    readonly code: string;
    readonly status: number;
    readonly callId: string | null;
    readonly body: unknown;
}

export interface UiRequestInit {
    readonly control?: boolean;
    readonly method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
    readonly body?: unknown;
    readonly file?: Blob;
    readonly as?: "json" | "text" | "response";
    readonly accept?: readonly number[];
    readonly key?: string;
    readonly headers?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly keepalive?: boolean;
    readonly scope?: UiRequestScope;
    readonly fallback?: string;
}

export interface UiRequestScope {
    readonly fetch: (input: string, init: object) => Promise<Response>;
    assertCurrent(signal?: AbortSignal): void;
}

export type UiResourceKind = (typeof UI_RESOURCE_KINDS)[number];

export interface UiResourceLicense {
    readonly spdx: string;
    readonly source: string;
    readonly notice_path?: string;
}

export type UiResourceLoad = (typeof UI_RESOURCE_LOADS)[number];

export interface UiResourceRegistry {
    readonly format_version: typeof UI_FORMAT_VERSIONS.registry;
    readonly resources: readonly UiResourceRow[];
}

export type UiResourceRow = (UiResourceFields & {
    readonly kind: Exclude<UiResourceKind, "font" | "asset">;
}) | (UiResourceFields & {
    readonly kind: "font" | "asset";
    readonly sha256: string;
    readonly license: UiResourceLicense;
});

export interface UiReturnCarry {

        readonly kind: string;
        readonly id: string;
    };

    readonly kind: "model";
};

    readonly status: "ready" | "not_ready";
    readonly carry: UiReturnCarry;
}

export type UiRgba = readonly [red: number, green: number, blue: number, alpha: number];

export type UiTerminalCommand = {
    type: "attach";
    panelId: string;
    cols?: number;
    rows?: number;
} | {
    type: "write";
    panelId: string;
    data: string;
} | {
    type: "resize";
    panelId: string;
    cols: number;
    rows: number;
} | {
    type: "kill";
    panelId: string;
};

export type UiTerminalEvent = {
    type: "disconnected";
} | {
    type: "spawned";
    panelId: string;
    attached: boolean;
    started: boolean;
    replay: string;
} | {
    type: "data";
    panelId: string;
    data: string;
} | {
    type: "exit";
    panelId: string;
    exitCode: number;
    signal: number;
} | {
    type: "error";
    panelId?: string;
    message: string;
};

export interface UiTerminalMountOptions {
    readonly panelId: string;
    readonly onEvent?: (event: UiTerminalEvent) => void;
}

export interface UiTerminalView {
    focus(): void;
    fit(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

export type UiTextDirection = "ltr" | "rtl";

export interface UiTextProvider {
    locale(): string | null;

    message(owner: string, key: string, locale: string): UiMessage | null;
    defaultLocale(owner: string): string | null;
    problem?(problem: {
        readonly code: string;
        readonly owner?: string;
        readonly key?: string;
        readonly locale?: string;
    }): void;
    produced?(output: string, ref: OwnedTextRef): void;
}

export type UiTokenValue = string | {
    readonly rgba: UiRgba;
} | {
    readonly role: string;
    readonly fallback?: string;
} | {
    readonly mix: {
        readonly role: string;
        readonly percent: number;
        readonly with: "transparent";
    };
} | {
    readonly shadow: readonly UiShadowLayer[];
} | {
    readonly px: number;
} | {
    readonly ms: number;
} | {
    readonly number: number;
} | {
    readonly bezier: readonly [number, number, number, number];
} | {
    readonly stroke: {
        readonly width_px: number;
        readonly style: "solid";
        readonly role: string;
    };
};
